name: Amazon Web Services
description: AWS Marketplace listings and SageMaker JumpStart deploy biological foundation models onto managed endpoints in the subscriber's own AWS account.

name: Benchling Model Hub
description: Managed structure prediction on registry data inside the electronic lab notebook, and on uploaded sequences from a standalone benchling.ai account.

name: Google Cloud Model Garden
description: Managed cloud endpoints for deploying and fine-tuning biological foundation models, billed per token or per node-hour depending on serving mode.

name: Hugging Face
description: Open repository for downloading protein, DNA, RNA, single-cell and pathology foundation model weights, with managed inference endpoints alongside.

name: NVIDIA BioNeMo / NIM
description: GPU-accelerated inference for structure prediction, protein design, docking and genomics, as hosted endpoints or self-hosted microservices.

name: Scigantic
description: Managed notebooks for fine-tuning open protein, DNA and molecule models from labelled sequence data, with no GPU setup and linked cloud storage.

name: Zenodo
description: Open research repository operated by CERN, hosting DOI-citable, versioned model weights archived alongside the papers that describe them.
